title: Must See Monday – Events of the Week: Bristol Summer Series, Ted Bundy Project & Look At Me Now
content:
29th June 2015

TIP OF THE WEEK

What: Bristol Summer Series // Where: Bristol Harbourside // When:  Weds 24th – Sat 27th June (6.30pm) // Cost: £33

Following last year’s inaugural Bristol Summer Series, promoters Metropolis Music return to Bristol’s Harbourside amphitheatre from 24th to 27th June, with a series of concerts from George Ezra, Kaiser Chiefs, Seasick Steve and Jessie J. 

Now in its second year the concert series will kick off with George Ezra on midsummer’s night Wednesday 24th June, returning to the city where he was discovered to play his first ever outdoor headline show. Next up will be a riproaring set from Kaiser Chiefs on Thursday 25th June, the raw soulful boogie of Seasick Steve on June 26th, with the amazing vocal talents of Jessie J taking to the stage on 27th June for a Saturday night extravaganza.

We will covering the shows in detail so check back each day.

To find out more click here.

OTHER TIPS

The Ted Bundy Project @ Bristol Old Vic // Tues 23rd – Sat 27th June (8pm) // Cost: £12/8


In November 2012, Greg stumbled upon the confession tapes of Ted Bundy, the American serial killer, rapist and necrophile. He couldn’t stop listening.

The Ted Bundy Project was born from a curiosity about the nature of charm, the label of ‘monster’ and the tension between attraction and repulsion.

Greg has a wig, a bit of rope, a few YouTube videos and Bundy’s confession tapes. Come and hear what he has to say to you.

 
To find out more then click here.

Look at Me Now @ The Little Black Box Theatre // Thurs 25th – Sat 27th (8pm) // Cost: £10/£8

Who’s that yonder, all in flames?

They say The Devil gets all the best tunes, and he has his own dominion to rule for all eternity. So what’s he got to be so angry about?

Join The Little Black Box Theatre Co. as they take you on a journey through a career spanning set of Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds’ music with just a pinch of John Milton for an experience like no other.

I’m transforming. I’m vibrating. Look At Me Now.

To find out more click here. 

Kevin McGough
